summary.text: Emma Greenman is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 63B who has served since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A lawyer by profession, she faces Republican Nicholas Peters in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Emma Greenman lives in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

She earned a B.A. in political science from George Washington University, an M.P.A. from Harvard University, and a J.D. from the University of California at Berkeley, and her career experience includes working as a lawyer.
Greenman won the August 2020 Democratic primary for District 63B over Jerome Evans and Husniyah Dent Bradley, then defeated Frank Pafko and Dennis Schuller in the November 2020 general election.
She took office on January 5, 2021, and was re-elected in 2022 and 2024.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Fraud Prevention and State Agency Oversight Policy, Public Safety and Criminal Justice Reform Finance and Policy, Elections Finance and Policy, and Workforce and Business Development Finance and Policy committees, serving as co-vice chair of the last.
